question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: A practice of not eating by day is described.
This practice leads to a future outcome.
The outcome concerns death related to age.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by age.
uncertainties: The exact sense of vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is ambiguous; it may mean overcoming or reaching age-related death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by age.
